facts.text: I used to be a more visual learner.
Now I prefer a more hands-on approach to learning.
Personal development and life experiences have played a role in my learning preference changing.
Sometimes a combination of visual and hands-on learning works best for me.
It depends on the subject matter for what learning method works best for me.
Taking breaks and coming back to material later helps me process and retain information better.
I tend to get hungry when I'm studying for a while.
I usually go for something sugary when I study.
I am going to try healthier snack options instead of something sugary while studying.
I need to drink more water while studying.
